reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = official as-reported series: the hand-curated USSR official series (one citation per point, curation gate ADR-0007) and UN DYB Table 15 rates across 13 editions (2015 recovered v10), 2007-2024 (published only for UN completeness codes C or "|"); witness tier = UN IGME harmonized estimates via OWID, the World Bank (WDI, sex-split, rounded print) and GHO for cross-country comparability — one root, four doors. notes:
THE tracer from the brief (Soviet infant mortality, Todd's method).
CANONICAL TIER (ADR-0008, Technique A chosen in conversation: "A" = the as-reported layer as source-of-record; the alternative "B" would have kept the harmonized series canonical and fallen back into the very smoothing problem this project exists to expose): - curated `ussr_infant_mortality_official`: the official Soviet series
  1970-1990 (22.9 in 1971, 27.9 in 1974, peak 31.4 in 1976, 21.8 in
  1990), one citation per point, per-row definition notes carrying the
  Soviet live-birth definition and the 1976-87 publication blackout.
  This is how the `ussr` entity finally gets a real series — the gap
  found in the live audit (OWID carries no standalone USSR entity in
  this chart) is resolved by the curated tier, not by fabrication.
- un_dyb Table 15, editions 2011-2014 + 2017-2024 (the loop, P1): an
  as-reported IMR series over 2007-2024, overlapping windows
  reconstructed edition by edition with intra-tier arbitration (later
  vintage wins, logged). Collector holes are data: Russia, the US,
  China, the UK are absent from the recent editions (questionnaire
  gaps) — they stay absent from the canonical series, with the named
  alternative routes (HMD, national offices) in the-measurement-
  problem.md section 4, until those connectors exist. The pre-2007 and
  1991-2006 as-reported history lives in the PDF-era editions (1948-2013
  plus the dead/encrypted 2015/2016) — deliberately NOT in this loop
  (see the-measurement-problem.md section 7 and ADR-0007's PDF-route
  gate).

WITNESS TIER (v11, one root — UN IGME — through four doors): - owid `infant-mortality` (UN IGME harmonized estimates, 1950-2023,
  near-global, both sexes) — the comparability backbone, converted from
  its native percentage into per-1,000 through the declared
  UNIT_CONVERSIONS table.
- worldbank SP.DYN.IMRT.MA.IN / SP.DYN.IMRT.FE.IN (WDI, sex-split,
  1960-2024): the same IGME estimates ROUNDED to at most one decimal —
  the honest coarseness of the WDI redistribution, verified live
  (France 2020 female prints 3 where OWID carries 3.3304706). Displayed
  as divergence beside the canonical series (the IGME 21.9 plateau vs
  the official 27.9-31.4 rise IS the founding case); never merged,
  never averaged.
- who_gho MDG_0000000001 (IGME, sex-split MLE/FMLE/BTSX, 1931-2024):
  value-identical to the OWID witness (verified live to the seventh
  significant digit) — wired precisely so the catalog can SAY "one
  root, four doors" from the data instead of from the docs.

UNIT HISTORY (live-network audits, see CHANGELOG): the OWID chart reports a percentage, not per-1,000 — the phase-1 fix declared the percentage as the indicator unit. Phase 2 (now): the canonical unit is per-1,000 (the field's native unit — DYB, official series, IGME all publish per-1,000; the OWID chart was the outlier), so the witness carries the x10 conversion instead of every other source carrying the x0.1 one.
